tileLegend.name: No Entry Zone
tileLegend.description: Can't deploy melee unit on it. Impassable

tileLegend.name: Flat Ground
tileLegend.description: Can deploy melee unit on it. Passable

tileLegend.name: Medical Rune
tileLegend.description: The Operator on it will recover HP over time.

tileLegend.name: High Ground
tileLegend.description: Can deploy ranged unit on it. Impassable

tileLegend.name: Active Originium
tileLegend.description: Increases ATK and ASPD of both friendly and enemy units that stand on it, but the affected units will lose HP over time.

tileLegend.name: Protection Objective
tileLegend.description: Blue objective point. Its HP decreases when an enemy unit enters it.

tileLegend.name: Incursion Point
tileLegend.description: Enemies will enter the battlefield from here.
